app.title: ropefit
app.tagline: Exact RoPE / YaRN long-context settings for llama.cpp, vLLM, SGLang and Ollama, plus a check for silent mistakes.
app.mock: Practice (mock) mode: the built-in sample models below are copied numbers, nothing is sent anywhere. No engine is started; rules follow the engine sources and docs linked on each result.

target.heading: 2. Target
plan.heading: Plan
plan.none: No scaling needed: {target} is within the original length {orig}.
plan.nativeKeep: Keep the model's own scaling, just set the context to {target}.
engine.label: Engine
block.convert-config: config.json fragment to set before converting to GGUF
kv.estimate: KV cache estimate: {gib} GiB ({dtype}, {tokens} tokens, weights not included)
kv.unsupported.mla: KV cache not estimated: this model uses multi-head latent attention.
kv.unsupported.sliding: KV cache not estimated: this model mixes sliding-window layers.
kv.unsupported.unknown-shape: KV cache not estimated: layer and head counts are unknown.
note.no-scaling-needed: The target fits the original length, so no RoPE scaling is needed. Only the context size is set.
note.native-keep: This model's own scaling already covers the target. Do not add a YaRN override.
note.native-scheme: This model uses its own scaling scheme (llama3, longrope or per-layer). Overriding it would break it.
note.already-yarn: The model config already ships YaRN that covers the target. Leave it as it is.
note.replaces-author-values: The model already has YaRN with a smaller factor. Your override replaces the author's values (it does not multiply).
note.orig-unverified: The original length is assumed to be max_position_embeddings. Check the model card and edit the value above if it differs.
note.beyond-native: The target is longer than the model's max_position_embeddings; quality beyond it is not covered by the model's own scheme.
note.vllm-v030-source-based: Source based: since vLLM 0.30 the YaRN factor no longer raises the derived length limit, so max_position_embeddings is overridden too. Verified in the source, not by running vLLM.
note.ollama-no-runtime: Ollama has no runtime RoPE or YaRN option (removed in v0.2.0). num_ctx only changes the window size. YaRN has to be inside the GGUF file, or you run the same model with llama.cpp.
note.ollama-num-ctx-window-only: num_ctx only sets the context window; it does not scale positions.
note.ollama-gguf-keys-cannot-be-added: gguf-set-metadata cannot add missing rope.scaling keys to a GGUF. Edit config.json and convert again, or use llama.cpp.
note.gguf-no-scaling-keys: This GGUF has no rope.scaling keys. llama.cpp then defaults to linear scaling if you pass --rope-scale without --rope-scaling yarn.
note.gguf-default-theta: The GGUF has no rope.freq_base; llama.cpp uses 10000.
note.gguf-rotary-dim-assumed: The GGUF does not state the rotary dimension; 128 is assumed for the chart.
check.heading: Check an existing command or config
check.empty: Paste a llama-server or vllm serve command, an SGLang launch command, a Modelfile, or a config.json fragment.
check.noFindings: No problems found by the {count} rules. This is a static check; it does not start the engine.
check.beyond: This vLLM version is newer than the last one checked ({version}). The newest rules are applied.
check.noModel: Pick a model above so checks that need its numbers (original length, theta) can run.
explain.heading: How YaRN changes each dimension
explain.chart: Wavelength (tokens per full turn, log scale) for each rotary dimension pair
explain.text: High-frequency dimensions (small wavelength) keep their values. Low-frequency dimensions are stretched by the factor. The ramp in between blends the two. Linear stretches every dimension, which blurs nearby positions.
error.hf.invalid-id: That is not a model ID. Use owner/name, for example Qwen/Qwen3-8B.
error.hf.not-found: No public config.json was found for that model ID.
error.hf.gated: That model is gated or private, so its config cannot be fetched without signing in.
error.hf.bad-json: The answer was not valid JSON.
error.pasteBadJson: The pasted text is not valid JSON. Paste the whole config.json, starting with '{'.
error.config.missing-key: config.json is missing a positive number for "{key}". Paste the full config.json of the model (the file next to the weights).
error.config.not-object: config.json must be a JSON object. Paste the whole file, starting with '{'.
error.config.no-theta: config.json has no "rope_theta" (neither at the top level nor inside rope_parameters). Add it from the model card or paste the original file.
error.config.no-head-dim: config.json needs "head_dim" or both "hidden_size" and "num_attention_heads" to compute the rotary dimension.
error.config.no-context: The GGUF header has no "{arch}.context_length". This file is not a usual language-model GGUF.
error.gguf.truncated: The file ends inside the GGUF header (truncated file?). Download the model file again.
error.gguf.huge-number: The GGUF header contains an implausibly large number.
error.gguf.long-string: The GGUF header contains an implausibly long string (not a GGUF file?).
error.gguf.unknown-type: Unknown GGUF value type {type}. The file may be corrupt or newer than this reader.
error.gguf.too-small: This file is too small to be a GGUF model. Pick a .gguf file.
error.gguf.bad-magic: Not a GGUF file (the "GGUF" marker bytes are missing). Pick a .gguf model file.
error.gguf.bad-version: Unsupported GGUF version {version}. This reader supports versions 2 and 3.
error.gguf.too-many: The GGUF header declares too many metadata entries (corrupt file?).
error.gguf.array-type: Unsupported array element type {type} for key "{key}".
error.gguf.no-arch: The GGUF header has no "general.architecture" entry.
error.gguf.generic: This GGUF file could not be read.
error.parse.unclosed-single: A single quote is not closed. Close the quote or paste the whole command.
error.parse.unclosed-double: A double quote is not closed. Close the quote or paste the whole command.
error.parse.unrecognized: The engine was not recognized. Start the command with llama-server, vllm serve or python -m sglang.launch_server.
error.parse.bad-json: {flag}: the value is not valid JSON (check the quotes around it).
error.parse.fragment-bad-json: The config fragment is not valid JSON.
error.parse.fragment-not-object: The config fragment must be a JSON object.
error.parse.generic: This input could not be read.
rule.VLLM_REMOVED_FLAG.title: vLLM {version} no longer has {flags}
rule.VLLM_REMOVED_FLAG.body: These flags were removed in vLLM 0.11.1 (PR #28006). Put the same settings into --hf-overrides instead.
rule.THETA_MISSING.title: The {key} override drops rope_theta
rule.THETA_MISSING.body: The override replaces the whole RoPE dictionary. Without rope_theta the base can fall back to 10000 and long inputs silently degrade (vLLM issue #58675). Add rope_theta next to factor.
rule.LINEAR_TRAP.title: --rope-scale alone means linear scaling (factor {factor})
rule.LINEAR_TRAP.body: Without --rope-scaling yarn llama.cpp interpolates every frequency linearly unless the GGUF already says yarn. Add --rope-scaling yarn and --yarn-orig-ctx.
rule.ORIG_CTX_MISMATCH.title: Original length would be {got}, not {expected}
rule.ORIG_CTX_MISMATCH.body: YaRN measures the factor from the pre-training length ({expected}). The engine would use {got}, which shifts the ramp. Pass --yarn-orig-ctx {expected} (original_max_position_embeddings in an override).
rule.FACTOR_TOO_SMALL.title: Factor {factor} x {base} = {capacity} is below the requested {ctx}
rule.FACTOR_TOO_SMALL.body: Positions beyond {capacity} are outside what this factor can cover. Use a factor of at least {need}.
rule.OVERRIDES_NATIVE.title: This model already uses its own {type} scaling
rule.OVERRIDES_NATIVE.body: Overriding llama3, longrope or per-layer schemes replaces what the model was trained with. Keep the model's config and only set the context length.
rule.REPLACES_AUTHOR_VALUES.title: The override replaces the author's YaRN values
rule.REPLACES_AUTHOR_VALUES.body: Overrides replace the model's rope settings, they do not multiply with them. This command loses or changes: {lost}. Copy the author's values into your override or leave the config alone.
rule.STATIC_YARN_OVERSIZED.title: Factor {factor} is larger than the {needed} needed for {ctx} tokens
rule.STATIC_YARN_OVERSIZED.body: Engines apply YaRN statically, so short inputs are affected too. Use the smallest factor that covers your length, or none if the original length is enough.
rule.VLLM_V030_MAXLEN.title: vLLM 0.30+ may reject --max-model-len {ctx} (cap {cap})
rule.VLLM_V030_MAXLEN.body: Since 0.30 the derived limit is max_position_embeddings without the YaRN factor (read in the vLLM source, not run). Also override max_position_embeddings, or set VLLM_ALLOW_LONG_MAX_MODEL_LEN=1.
rule.OLLAMA_NO_RUNTIME_ROPE.title: Ollama ignores {params}
rule.OLLAMA_NO_RUNTIME_ROPE.body: Ollama has no runtime RoPE parameters since v0.2.0. The values must be inside the GGUF, or run the model with llama.cpp.
rule.KV_EXCEEDS_VRAM.title: KV cache {kv} GiB is larger than {vram} GiB of VRAM at {ctx} tokens
rule.KV_EXCEEDS_VRAM.body: The cache alone does not fit, and the weights come on top. Lower the context, quantize the KV cache, or use more memory.
